Sam (Onboarding): Hi team 1 starting FableRetail onboarding thread. Goal: pilot storefront in 30 days, handoff to Success Ops by day 42. Need owners, hard success metrics, and any early blockers. 20-30m kickoff today/tomorrow?

Rae (CSM): I can do tomorrow 11am PT. I'll lead weekly health and comms.

Ibrahim (Solutions Eng): Tomorrow 11am PT ok. Need infra POC (VPC/allowlist) and data sensitivity note.

Tanya - FableRetail (Customer): 11am works. We prefer starting in hosted sandbox, plan VPC peering later. I'll share infra contact and prompt set (~6k) before kickoff.

Sam (Onboarding): Draft success criteria: 1) sandbox E2E flow; 2) acceptance pass on the labeled set; 3) baseline DAU target for renewal signal; 4) enablement session recorded + runbook. Additions?

Lina (Renewals): Add procurement_watch 1 they mentioned a finance review in ~45 days. I'll flag and assign renewal buddy.

Noah (Enablement): I'll prepare quickstart + 30-min recording; recommend live Q&A on day 5 post-integration.

Ibrahim (Solutions Eng): Tech checklist I'll bring: API key, sample payloads, model recommendation (redwood/opt-13b-quant), and a small load test. Sanity curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood/test-small","input":"hello"}'
```

Sam (Onboarding): @calendar-bot please create 25m kickoff tomorrow 14:00 ET / 11:00 PT. Agenda: intros, confirm success metrics, infra checklist, owners.

calendar-bot: Created event "FableRetail 1 Onboard Prep" for 2026-07-12 14:00 ET.

Tanya - FableRetail (Customer): I'll upload infra POC + prompts pre-meeting.

Sam (Onboarding): Action recap: Tanya share infra contact + prompts; Ibrahim post tech checklist (1 day post); Rae draft 30/60/90 and DAU targets (3 days); Noah deliver enablement pack (day 5); Lina add procurement_watch in CRM.

Sam (Onboarding): Noted private-deploy need would add ~3 weeks. Tanya please confirm if peering required early.

Tanya - FableRetail (Customer): We'll start sandbox and confirm peering after pilot. See you at kickoff.
